_note: Run from a terminal session connected to Remote Control (SendMessage is disabled in the desktop app and its subagents). Targets must be online.

evals.prompt: My workspace session runs on the Mac in ~/src/<project>. Ask it to run the frontend tests and tell me the real result when it is done, not just 'message sent'.
evals.expected_output: ListAgents, SendMessage with the envelope (TAG + sentinel + callback), wait, get_run_log read of the target's session_… ID, report quoting the real tool_result lines (test counts, errors) and the session ID.

evals.prompt: what did the pi-lab session do in the last hour? I sent nothing, I just want to know
evals.expected_output: No SendMessage. ID resolution (registry / URL / message header / script), get_run_log, timestamped summary of turns and tools, mention of any errors.

evals.prompt: i have 3 remote control sessions (workspace, build-box, pi-lab). ask each one which node version is installed and make me a table. one of them may be offline
evals.expected_output: One message per target with a distinct TAG, one read per ID, table name/ID/status/version, offline status reported without resending in a loop, log kept.
